title: ジャパンCの後に・キラキラ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is over… and City and I both got what we wanted. We both crossed that finish line loving who we've become!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I got a whole bunch of cheers and applause, and afterward, I got a message from Mifuyu too. She said she passed her badge test!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: "We're both one step closer to our dreams—me to becoming a city girl, and Mifuyu to competing in the world championships!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So, Mom and Dad… I'm real sorry for worrying you before. But trust me, I'm fine now… I mean, I love who I am now more than ever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: That's why there's no way I can let it all end here. I'm gonna keep on doing my darndest until I'm trendy again, but this time, it'll be on my terms!
